gaps.lead: The children were excited about opening the presents.
gaps.sentence: The children were excited ___ the presents.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action starting in the past and continuing: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: The famine was caused by a long drought.
gaps.explanation: A causes B = A results in B.

gaps.lead: The plane had just taken off when the warning light appeared.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ when the warning light appeared.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a very short time before.

gaps.lead: The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ reaching the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.

gaps.lead: People say the castle is haunted.
gaps.explanation: People say → It is said… / The castle is said to be…
